title: Meet India

body.heading: Where in the world is India?
paragraphs: India is a country in Southern Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of India is New Delhi.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in India speak Hindi and English. And that is just the start — India has hundreds of languages in all, more than almost any other country.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of India is the Indian rupee.

body.heading: How big is India?
paragraphs: India covers about 3,288,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Iran.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: The Taj Mahal in Agra was built as a marble mausoleum during the Mughal Empire. It is built from white marble that seems to change colour with the light, and it is one of the most famous buildings on Earth.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Taj Mahal is a white marble mausoleum built by an emperor for his wife, inlaid with flowers of semi-precious stone. It glows pink at sunrise and silver by moonlight.
Jaipur's old city is painted terracotta-pink, with the honeycomb Hawa Mahal palace, the hilltop Amber Fort and bazaars full of gems, puppets and sweets.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find India on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: India in one breath: a country in Southern Asia, capital New Delhi, where people speak Hindi and pay with the Indian rupee.
